tagline: Two layers of foam and an open front, so they walk on rather than climb in.
lead: Your dog steps straight on, lies down on fleece, and has three bolstered sides to lean a chin, back or hip against.
value: A second foam layer doesn't show in a photo, so it's often left out. Here there are two: one to contour, one to support.
intro: Yew is a memory foam bolster dog bed with memory foam over an egg-crate layer, bolsters on three sides, an open front, a fleece sleeping surface, linen-effect sides and a non-slip base. Large and XL.
points: They walk straight on, instead of standing on the edge and crushing it flat.
An edge for a chin, a back or a hip once they are down.
One layer to contour, one to support.
Soft where they lie, presentable where you see it.
It stays put on wood, laminate and tile.
best_for: Dogs who pause before stepping into their bed, or stand on the edge and flatten it, in rooms where the bed is on show.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. The bolsters take up part of the outside size. Between Large and XL? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover, then air-dry it fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

seo_description: A memory foam bolster dog bed they walk straight onto, with three sides to lean on. Two foam layers, fleece top, linen-effect sides. Large and XL.
